description: This file defines a class NullStateGrain that inherits from Grain<NullableState> and implements INullStateGrain, providing methods to set, get, and deactivate the grain's state.

classes.name: NullStateGrain
classes.description: A grain class managing a NullableState, with functionality to set state, write state asynchronously, and deactivate on idle.

methods.name: SetStateAndDeactivate
methods.description: Sets the grain's state to the provided NullableState, writes the state asynchronously, and deactivates the grain when idle.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the grain as a Task.
